scripts.icons: tauri icon icons/app-icon.png --output icons/generated && cp icons/generated/icon.icns icons/icon.icns && cp icons/generated/128x128@2x.png icons/icon.png && rm -r icons/generated
scripts.build: npm run build:client && tauri build --bundles app
scripts.build:local: npm run build:client && FRACTAL_APP_URL=http://127.0.0.1:8001 tauri build --bundles app --config local.conf.json
